description: Van Der Pol Osc: an oscillator made by integrating the Van der Pol equation, which oscillates on its own and can also be driven by an audio input

params.text: Sets the damping term of the equation, 0.001 to 9, which is what makes the waveform depart from a sine
Offsets the self-oscillation frequency, up to 5 octaves either way
Attenuates the audio input before it drives the equation
Attenuverts the damping modulation input, -100 to +100%

inputs.text: Sets the self-oscillation pitch, one octave per volt, scaled by its attenuator
Audio driving the equation, scaled by the input gain
Adds to the damping, scaled by its attenuverter

outputs.text: The oscillator output, after the output level

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
